forces.title: Global wellness economy growth accelerates spending in adjacent categories.
forces.description: The global wellness economy is projected to grow at an approximate 8% annual rate through 2030, outperforming many discretionary sectors. This robust expansion creates significant tailwinds for the Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals sector as consumers increasingly broaden their spending across diverse wellness categories, including nutrition and various weight-loss solutions. This trend directly fuels demand for dietary supplements, functional foods, and other related health products.
forces.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

forces.title: Expanding holistic wellness definition drives broader consumer investment.
forces.description: Consumers are increasingly redefining fitness and health through a holistic lens, encompassing overall well-being beyond mere exercise. This expanded perspective includes improving cardiovascular health, managing weight, supporting longevity, and enhancing mental well-being. This structural shift prompts consumers to invest across a broader spectrum of wellness categories, including nutrition and specific health solutions, directly benefiting the dietary supplements, nutraceuticals, and functional foods segments within Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals.
forces.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

forces.title: Expanding GLP-1 drug usage shifts consumer food and wellness demand.
forces.description: The rapid growth in GLP-1 weight-loss drug adoption, with 2% of EU+UK adults currently using them and usage set to increase, is fundamentally altering consumer food preferences. This structural change drives a reduction in overall calorie intake and a notable shift away from categories like savoury snacks, candy, and chocolate. Consequently, it compels the food and beverage industry to focus on reformulation and offer nutrient-dense, high-protein, and fibre-enriched products, directly impacting the market for Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals.
forces.source_title: Transformative or overhyped? The impact of weight-loss drugs on European food…

forces.title: GLP-1 drugs drive demand for high-protein, nutrient-dense functional foods.
forces.description: The widespread adoption of GLP-1 weight-loss medications is increasingly steering consumer diets towards more nutrient-dense, high-protein, and fibre-enriched food products. This trend presents a significant upside opportunity for the Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals sector. Manufacturers are responding with product innovation, including reformulations, smaller portions, and premiumization, while retailers are expanding their offerings to cater to these evolving dietary needs, thereby boosting market growth for functional foods and supplements.
forces.source_title: Transformative or overhyped? The impact of weight-loss drugs on European food…

forces.title: Mid-sized pharma M&A targets growth in Consumer Healthcare (CHC).
forces.description: European mid-sized pharmaceutical companies are strategically utilizing mergers and acquisitions to diversify and enhance their portfolios. Consumer Healthcare (CHC) has been identified as a significant area for investment, alongside rare diseases, to drive growth. This trend signals increasing M&A activity and financial interest within the broader consumer health market. Such investments can spur innovation, expand market reach, and consolidate the Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals sector, providing an upside driver through new capital and strategic focus.
forces.source_title: Accelerating Growth and Innovation in European Mid-Sized Pharma

viewpoints.title: Global wellness economy growth offers opportunities for adjacent categories.
viewpoints.description: The global wellness economy is forecasted to expand at an 8% compound annual growth rate through 2030, surpassing many discretionary spending categories. This robust expansion is driven by consumers adopting a more holistic view of wellness, prompting increased investment in a wider array of categories, including nutrition and weight loss solutions. Activewear brands are positioned to leverage this trend, indicating a positive outlook for the broader wellness ecosystem, particularly for businesses involved in dietary supplements and functional foods.
viewpoints.source_title: As Wellness Spending Grows, Can Activewear Brands Seize the Opportunity?

viewpoints.title: GLP-1 drugs reshape European food demand, favoring functional food innovation.
viewpoints.description: ING Think assesses that the global GLP-1 market, projected to reach $100bn by late 2027, will gradually reshape European food demand. With an estimated 2% current adult usage in EU+UK and growing, GLP-1s are driving a shift away from certain categories like snacks and towards nutrient-dense, high-protein, and fibre-enriched products. This necessitates product reformulation, portion control, and premiumization from food makers, creating a cautiously positive outlook for adaptable companies in the Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals sector.
viewpoints.source_title: Transformative or overhyped? The impact of weight-loss drugs on European food…

viewpoints.title: GLP-1 drugs to intensify innovation in nutrient-dense and functional foods.
viewpoints.description: Bank of Ireland highlights that the emergence of GLP-1 appetite-suppressing drugs is fundamentally altering consumer diets, steering preferences towards nutrient-dense foods. This shift is compelling the food and drink industry to significantly accelerate product innovation. Additionally, major retailers are actively expanding their product ranges to cater to consumers using GLP-1s, fostering a highly supportive market environment for the Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals sector to introduce specialized and health-focused products.
viewpoints.source_title: Bank of Ireland Sectors Team — Food and Drink Sector H2 2025 Insights and H1 2026 Outlook

demand_drivers.description: Significant societal and economic problems driving demand for effective weight management and diabetes treatments.
Users typically lose 12-22% of body weight, making these drugs a powerful tool for weight reduction.
Expected lower prices (up to 50%) with oral formulations will likely lead to higher usage and market penetration.
More companies launching drugs and potential government reimbursement will further increase demand and market size.

new_opportunities.description: Food and beverage companies are focusing on reformulation, smaller portions, premiumization, and offering high-protein and fibre-enriched products, aligning with GLP-1 users' evolving dietary needs.

market_sizing.methodology: Forecast of the global market size for GLP-1 drugs, including treatments for diabetes and weight loss. This market is driven by rising obesity rates, the effectiveness of GLP-1s, the transition to lower-priced oral formulations, increased competition, and potential government reimbursement for prevention, which influences demand for complementary wellness products.

market_sizing.methodology: Estimated total Over-The-Counter (OTC) sales by value in Greece. This category broadly includes non-prescription medicines and self-care products, often encompassing dietary supplements, vitamins, and functional health products sold through pharmacy channels, which are integral to the Wellness, FMCH & Nutraceuticals sector.
